model_note: Adaption hosted deployment of qwen3.5-397b, the larger-model contrast in this registration, reached through the Adaption Responses API at POST {ADAPTION_BASE_URL}/responses. The served identity is not verified by this config: hosted availability varies by key, so run 'verify --config configs/adaption_qwen35_397b.json' and confirm this model id appears in GET /models?type=hosted before reporting any result under this name. Documented price per 1M tokens: 0.55 input, 3.50 output, which is the most expensive of the three registered families and the reason its sweep is run last. json_mode is false because the Responses API has no response_format field, so the strict JSON reply is requested by the frozen prompt alone and a non-JSON reply is recorded as a parse error. The Responses API also accepts no seed: a seed value here indexes an independent draw rather than a reproducible one, so a rerun reproduces a run only from the reply cache, and replay needs ADAPTION_BASE_URL set to the same value because the base URL is part of the cache key.
